caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular panel with a relief-style image rendered primarily in shades of gray. Within the panel, there is a dog facing left with its nose near the ground, and its body is partially obscured by multiple clusters of tall, pointed grass-like plants. Above the dog, there are three birds in flight, spaced out in the upper portion of the panel. The background of the panel also includes slight textural details and shading, while the area outside the rectangular panel is left blank and unadorned, with the plain off-white paper visible. The edges of the panel are straight, and the drawing overall gives a three-dimensional appearance to the elements within the central rectangle.
title: Relief Panel of Dog
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
